answer: Iris-code enrolment makes each extra identity pay one distinct iris, bought for as little as $30; a farm running N fakes pays N×$30 and cannot share it because one iris hashes to one code and its owner must appear live at every re-check. The Orb files each code against 18 million enrolled irises; a cedar planted twice on one ridge is spotted at once, and the tundra between seats is a live check that no photo can cross. A farm reusing one iris dies by iris-code dedup at 2: the second seat flags both and burns both seats, forfeiting every reward.
